{{- $value := .value -}} {{- with index $value "$ref" -}} {{- $parts := split . "/" -}} {{- if or (ne (len $parts) 4) (ne (index $parts 0) "#") (ne (index $parts 1) "components") -}} {{- errorf "Unsupported OpenAPI reference: %q" . -}} {{- end -}} {{- $section := index $.components (index $parts 2) -}} {{- $resolved := index $section (index $parts 3) -}} {{- if not $resolved -}} {{- errorf "Unresolved OpenAPI reference: %q" . -}} {{- end -}} {{- $value = $resolved -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $value -}}
